doc: Allowlist of migrations whose SQL was NOT produced by `drizzle-kit generate`. Every entry must have a rationale that survives a code review. The migration-journal validator hard-fails on hand-written migrations (`ADD CONSTRAINT` outside DO $$ block, `DROP CONSTRAINT` without IF EXISTS, missing snapshot) UNLESS their tag appears here AND meets the per-tag conditions below.

custom.rationale: PG PL/pgSQL trigger (enforce_account_membership_seat_limit) plus BEFORE INSERT / UPDATE OF status trigger on account_memberships — DB-level backstop for the app-level guard at apps/server/src/lib/seat-count-guard.ts. CR8-P2-03 defense-in-depth. Not expressible in Drizzle's schema DSL (no schema changes; trigger + function only).
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Snapshot would be a copy of 0006's snapshot (this migration adds no Drizzle-modeled columns/tables), but is omitted to avoid confusion, matching the 0002_triggers_search_vectors precedent.

custom.rationale: Hand-written ALTER TABLE on jobs adding locked_by/locked_until/last_error columns plus a partial index on (locked_until) WHERE state = 'active'. CR8-P2-01 phase A — durable work queue visibility-timeout semantics. drizzle-kit can model the columns but not the partial-index predicate (WHERE clause inside CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS), and the ADD COLUMN statements are wrapped in IF NOT EXISTS for idempotent re-apply. Companion Drizzle schema update at packages/db/src/schema/jobs.ts adds the columns + partial index for type-safety; callers query via Drizzle, not raw SQL.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0003: snapshot regeneration via `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the shared-facts/yjs/shared-memory debt is worked through. Deferred to keep phase A scoped.

custom.rationale: Hand-written CREATE TABLE + indexes for the `unreconciled_webhooks` table. The table was defined in packages/db/src/schema/webhook-reconciliation.ts and already appears in the Drizzle snapshots at meta/0006_snapshot.json and meta/0009_snapshot.json, but NO .sql migration ever created it (verified 2026-04-22: grep -n 'unreconciled' migrations/*.sql → zero hits). Production likely has the table from an ad-hoc drizzle-kit push at some point (webhooks.ts writes to it at runtime; if prod didn't have it, webhook processing would be failing). Migration uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS so it is safe to apply against both fresh DBs (creates it) and prod (no-op). Partial index `unreconciled_webhooks_unresolved_idx` on (created_at) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL is not expressible in Drizzle's schema DSL beyond the .where() modifier.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Snapshot already captures the table (meta/0006_snapshot.json + meta/0009_snapshot.json reference it). Missing snapshot for this tag specifically because it's a retroactive catch-up for an unmigrated table; the canonical snapshot state is the 0009 snapshot. Full snapshot regen deferred to the general snapshot-debt backfill tracked alongside 0003/0004/0005/0008.

custom.rationale: A.3 of the post-v1 MCP arc — adds two nullable columns (`duration_ms` bigint, `errored` boolean) to `usage_meters` so the new `/admin/mcp` Usage tab can plot p50/p95 duration buckets + success/error rate per meterName. Hand-written with `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` so it's idempotent against any prod environment that already applied an ad-hoc `drizzle-kit push` for the schema change. drizzle-kit produces functionally equivalent SQL (`ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ...` without the IF NOT EXISTS guard), but the descriptive tag + idempotency match the 0010 precedent for this kind of small column-addition migration.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0003/0004/0005/0008/0010: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/accounts.ts already adds the columns at the type level; consumers query via Drizzle, not raw SQL, so the type contract is intact.

custom.rationale: I-1 from Phase 1 payment audit: licenses.user_id had ON DELETE CASCADE, silently destroying license rows (billing audit evidence) when a user was deleted. drizzle-kit generate cannot express a FK-mode change (CASCADE → SET NULL) without dropping and re-adding the constraint, which it does non-idempotently. Hand-written to use bare DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS + DO $$ ADD CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object for full idempotency. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/licenses.ts changes the FK option and makes userId nullable.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Drizzle schema change at licenses.ts already reflects the nullable userId + SET NULL FK so type consumers are correct.

custom.rationale: I-2 from Phase 1 payment audit: GDPR Article 17 erasure path never called stripe.customers.del, leaving EU PII in Stripe. Adds stripe_deletion_status (text, CHECK IN ('deleted','failed')) and stripe_deletion_at (timestamptz) to users table to record Stripe-side erasure outcome. Hand-written with ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + DO $$ CHECK CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object for idempotency. drizzle-kit generates ADD COLUMN without IF NOT EXISTS guard; the idempotency requirement mandates the hand-written form per the 0011 precedent.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries. Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/users.ts adds stripeDeletionStatus and stripeDeletionAt columns at the type level; consumers query via Drizzle ORM.

custom.rationale: GAP-340 P1 fleet knowledge graph: CREATE TABLE for kg_episodes/kg_nodes/kg_edges/kg_edge_episodes/kg_node_aliases/kg_outbox. Hand-written because the migration adds pgvector vector(768) columns + HNSW indexes (vector_cosine_ops), tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS STORED columns + GIN indexes, and partial current-edge indexes (WHERE invalid_at IS NULL AND expired_at IS NULL) — none expressible in Drizzle's schema DSL, following the 0002_triggers_search_vectors precedent. All statements are CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS with inline REFERENCES/CHECK (no ALTER ADD CONSTRAINT), idempotent against fresh + re-applied environments. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/knowledge-graph.ts models the plain columns for ORM typing.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0002/0003/0008: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the pgvector-column snapshot debt is worked through. The Drizzle schema at knowledge-graph.ts already reflects the tables at the type level; the graph package queries retrieval-heavy paths via raw SQL and Drizzle inserts otherwise.

custom.rationale: GAP-349 FTS name-normalization fix: kg_nodes carried real fleet-scan rows on Neon with `revkg search "electric proxy"` returning 0 hits, because Postgres's english tsvector parser tokenizes file/path-like names (`electric-proxy.ts`, `apps/admin/src/lib/api/electric-proxy.ts`) as single opaque tokens, so word-level `websearch_to_tsquery` queries never matched. Adds `search_text` (a normalized name+naturalKey+summary rendering written by the ingest engine on every node upsert; separators/camelCase-boundaries become spaces, no regex per the fleet no-regex rule) and drops+recreates the generated `search` tsvector column to index it instead of name+summary (Postgres has no ALTER COLUMN ... SET EXPRESSION). Not expressible via drizzle-kit generate because it both backfills existing rows (DML) and rebuilds a GENERATED STORED column plus its dependent GIN index, following the 0021 precedent for this table. All statements are idempotent (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS / DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS). Backfill scope: this migration's SQL backfill normalizes separators only (plain replace(), no regex); camelCase-boundary normalization is not expressible in plain SQL and completes incrementally as each node is re-upserted by a future scan (the ingest engine always writes full normalization; see the migration's header comment). Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/knowledge-graph.ts adds the searchText column.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0021: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the pgvector-column snapshot debt is worked through. The Drizzle schema at knowledge-graph.ts already reflects searchText at the type level; the graph package queries retrieval-heavy paths via raw SQL and Drizzle inserts otherwise.

custom.rationale: GAP-356 revenue blocker: widens account_entitlements_status_check to allow 'trialing' (the customer.subscription.created handler writes raw subscription.status into the entitlement upsert, so every trial checkout's entitlement INSERT threw a check violation and paying trial customers got no entitlement row) and adds nullable last_event_at to account_subscriptions + account_entitlements for the event-to-event staleness guard. Hand-written because a CHECK-constraint widening needs an idempotent drop/re-add: DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS + DO $$ ADD CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object + ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, following the 0014/0015 precedent. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/accounts.ts widens the check() and adds the lastEventAt columns.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. The Drizzle schema at accounts.ts already reflects the widened constraint and lastEventAt columns at the type level; webhooks.ts queries via Drizzle.

custom.rationale: GAP-360 PR-1 provider-surface widening: adds 'anthropic' and 'openai' to the provider CHECK on user_api_keys and workspace_inference_configs (and to the workspace_inference_configs key-pairing CHECK, in the keyed/non-NULL branch alongside groq/huggingface). Hand-written because a CHECK-constraint widening needs an idempotent drop/re-add: DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS + DO $$ ADD CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object, following the 0014/0015/0023 precedent. Constraint-widening only, no backfill. tenant_provider_configs is intentionally untouched — it has no provider CHECK in the schema, so there is nothing to widen. Companion Drizzle schema changes at packages/db/src/schema/api-keys.ts and inference-configs.ts widen the check() calls.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. The Drizzle schema at api-keys.ts + inference-configs.ts already reflects the widened constraints at the type level; consumers query via Drizzle.

custom.rationale: GAP-300 §7 in-product nudge surface: CREATE TABLE for nudge_dismissals (server-tracked per-user-per-nudge snooze state). Hand-written because `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against the current meta/ state bundles in unrelated pre-existing drift: snapshots are missing for 0021-0024 (already tracked in this file), so drizzle-kit diffs against the stale 0020 snapshot and re-emits CREATE TABLE for the kg_* tables 0021/0022 already created, plus the 0023/0024 CHECK/column changes. This migration is hand-scoped to only the new table to avoid re-shipping that unrelated drift. All statements use CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS and a DO $$ ADD CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object guard for the FK, following the 0010/0014/0021 precedent. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/nudges.ts models the table for ORM typing.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Blocked on the same pre-existing 0021-0024 snapshot-debt backfill this entry documents — a correct 0025 snapshot can't be generated until that backfill runs, since `db:generate` would otherwise bundle in the unrelated drift described above. Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once that backfill happens.

custom.rationale: GAP-355 Stage 2 PR-2: enforce audit_log append-only at the DB layer + add monotonic seq + tenant scope. Hand-written because the core of it is a PL/pgSQL trigger (enforce_audit_log_append_only) + BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger that RAISEs — not expressible in Drizzle's schema DSL, following the 0002_triggers_search_vectors / 0007 precedent. A plain REVOKE is toothless against the table-owner role the app connects as (owners bypass table privileges), so the trigger is the real enforcement and the REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE FROM PUBLIC is defense-in-depth for future non-owner roles. Also adds `seq` (bigserial, DB-assigned monotonic order — deletion-gap detectable) and `tenant` (nullable) via ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, idempotent against fresh + re-applied environments. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/audit-log.ts models seq + tenant + their indexes for ORM typing.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader 0021-0025 snapshot-debt backfill happens (db:generate against the current stale-0020 snapshot would otherwise re-emit the unrelated kg_*/CHECK drift). The Drizzle schema at audit-log.ts already reflects seq + tenant at the type level; consumers query via DrizzleAuditStore / Drizzle ORM.

custom.rationale: GAP-355 S4-1 hand-written CREATE TABLE audit_anchors + indexes + CHECK constraints. Hand-written so ADD CONSTRAINT uses DO $$ BEGIN ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object for idempotency (drizzle-kit does not emit that form). Companion Drizzle schema: packages/db/src/schema/audit-anchors.ts.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Snapshot deferred to shared snapshot-debt backfill; schema is fully modeled in audit-anchors.ts for type consumers.

custom.rationale: GAP-302 residual (b): DROP COLUMN licenses.npm_username. Column was never written at runtime (perpetual package access is GitHub-team based via github_username + provisionGitHubAccess). Hand-written single-statement DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS for idempotency. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/licenses.ts removes the field so types match the DB.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Schema at licenses.ts already omits npmUsername at the type level.

custom.rationale: GAP-429 item 4: partial index (tenant, seq) WHERE signature IS NULL supporting legacyUnsignedFloor() on the anchors request path and the no-anchor sweep pass. Hand-written for the CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idempotent form with a partial-index predicate, following the 0008_jobs_visibility_timeout precedent. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/audit-log.ts adds the same index via .where() for type-level modeling.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. A generate attempt from this branch re-emitted the 0028/0029 drift on top of the stale 0027 snapshot, confirming the debt is shared, not new.

custom.rationale: GAP-447 existence-classified hole traversal: adds nullable `holes` jsonb column to audit_anchors recording burned seqs + foreign-scope-row count traversed within an anchor's range. Hand-written for the single ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS idempotent statement, following the 0011/0015/0030 column-addition precedent. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/audit-anchors.ts adds the holes column (jsonb, typed via $type<AuditAnchorHoles>()) for type-safety; the security package's signAuditAnchorRoot/verifyAuditAnchorRoot cover the field in the signed payload only when present, so pre-existing anchors (NULL holes) verify unchanged.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. The Drizzle schema at audit-anchors.ts already reflects the holes column at the type level; the sweep + verify paths query via Drizzle ORM / the security package's pure functions.

custom.rationale: GAP-260 P4-5: CREATE TABLE license_jti_revocations for per-token (jti) denylist revocation without rotating the vendor Ed25519 key. Hand-written CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency, following the 0010/0021/0025 table-creation precedent. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/license-jti-revocations.ts; app-layer sticky denylist at packages/db/src/license-jti-denylist.ts (fail-open for unknown jtis, sticky once observed revoked).
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Schema modeled for ORM typing; denylist writes/reads go through Drizzle.

custom.rationale: GAP-444: ADD COLUMN account_entitlements.source (text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'stripe') + CHECK (stripe|grant|reconciler) so gifted entitlements can be excluded from MRR. Hand-written with ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + DO $$ ADD CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object for idempotency, following the 0023/0015 column+check precedent. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/accounts.ts models source + check + index; buildHostedEntitlementValues locksteps stripe/grant/reconciler writers.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Schema at accounts.ts already reflects source at the type level.

custom.rationale: GAP-464 / revealui#449 Phase 1: CREATE TABLE account_sso_providers + sso_identities for Enterprise SSO (OIDC|SAML). Hand-written CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + DO $$ ADD CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object + partial unique index WHERE deleted_at IS NULL, following the 0025/0032 table-creation precedent. Hand-scoped because meta snapshots lag and db:generate would re-emit unrelated drift. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/sso.ts; secrets are vault path refs only (client_secret_ref).
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Schema at sso.ts already models both tables for ORM typing.

custom.rationale: Hand-written CREATE TABLE kit_fulfillments for GAP-448 Phase 2-A stamp/deliver. Scoped CREATE + IF NOT EXISTS indexes + DO $$ FK guards (same pattern as 0034 SSO). No private key columns. Snapshot debt deferred with peer migrations until clean regen.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0034_gap464_account_sso_providers; Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/kit-fulfillments.ts is the type contract.

custom.rationale: GAP-448 Phase 2-A: ADD COLUMN kit_fulfillments.artifact (jsonb thin package) + customer_id index after P2-1 #2393 created the base table without artifact storage. Hand-written ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency, following the 0011/0031 column-addition precedent. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/kit-fulfillments.ts models artifact via $type<KitFulfillmentArtifact>().
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Schema already models artifact at the type level.

custom.rationale: GAP-175: ADD COLUMN coordination_file_claims.expires_at (timestamptz nullable) + btree index so the RevDev daemon dual-write can store file-reservation TTL and sweepExpiredFileClaims can DELETE expired Neon rows. Hand-written ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency, following the 0011/0031/0036 column-addition precedent. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/coordination.ts models expiresAt; daemon writes ISO expires_at on files.reserve.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Schema already models expiresAt at the type level.

custom.rationale: GAP-176: rebuild coordination_mail with UUID primary key (was SERIAL) so the RevDev daemon can dual-write the same id used in PGlite agent_messages and markRead without subject/body heuristics. Hand-written table rebuild + gen_random_uuid() backfill ordered by old serial id; no FKs reference coordination_mail.id. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/coordination.ts models id as uuid().
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Schema already models UUID id at the type level.

custom.rationale: GAP-256 PR-1: CREATE TABLE margin_snapshots, account_margin_daily, admission_waitlist; ADD COGS breaker columns on account_entitlements; widen source CHECK to include signup. Hand-written IF NOT EXISTS / DO $$ for idempotency and partial unique index WHERE status='pending' (not fully expressible via plain drizzle-kit without snapshot debt). Companion Drizzle schemas: packages/db/src/schema/margin-admission.ts + accounts.ts cogsBreaker* + source check.
